completed_in_this_slice: A blocking Linux CI job is a dependency of Required CI Gate.
CMake exposes check-fuzz-policy and two CTest policy checks without compiling C++.
Strict JSON schemas reject duplicate keys, floats, non-finite values, excess depth, unknown fields, and invalid types.
Manifest, source, target, and corpus paths are repository-confined regular files/directories; aliases and hard links fail closed.
The source scan is deterministic and bounded by roots, extensions, files, directories, bytes, depth, and wall time.
Every fuzzed parser must bind an existing harness, CMake target, CTest selector, non-empty corpus, and static input/time/memory/depth budgets.
not_completed: No production parser has a libFuzzer/AFL harness.
No seed corpus or runtime resource budget is bound to a production fuzz target.
Detected candidate backlog still requires manual classification.
ASan/UBSan fuzz smoke and scheduled campaigns are not implemented.
Production entry-point behavior has not been proven safe for malformed input.
